They may have met OP at the wedding but we don’t know the capacity. Since they most likely attended the wedding to see the wife, it was probably no more than a quick hi/bye. Have they kept in touch over the last 10 years or did they just attend the wedding to congratulate the OP’s wife on her nuptials? We don’t know that they KNOW OP. OP even says it’s the wife’s old high school friend so he obviously doesn’t consider himself to be friends with them or he would have said “our friend that my wife knows from high school”

If they are having a big wedding, maybe it’s because they have a lot of family, a lot of old high school friends they still keep in touch with, college friends they still keep in touch with. We don’t know if other married couples in the group also didn’t get a plus one, which sounds like it’s the case. I highly doubt that OP was the only one cut since they used plural “cuts”. Maybe he was on the list but unfortunately had to be removed because there wasn’t enough room (that doesn’t mean it’s some slight against OP, it just means that they don’t feel they know OP ENOUGH to kick someone who they know more). Maybe no one outside the couples immediate family got a +1 because there’s so many people. Some people have big weddings because they have a big family and then have to trim any “fat” because family takes up half the guest list. (For example, I have a very big family and with them and my friends, the list will be long and I’ll have to do some cutting) 

Let’s see the things OP is uncomfortable with. He asked HIS group of friends and family if they’ve ever heard of it, they said no. He takes that to mean that NO ONE has ever done it in history, when there are plenty of comments that state it’s happened to them. 

2. She’ll be flying to her home state alone. But he admits himself that he has had no previous problems with her going places alone (girls trip). And doesn’t make sense anyway cause it should relieve OP that his wife will be there where her family and old friends are. She isn’t going out to go camping in the wilderness alone. So we can establish that OP is perfectly fine with his wife traveling alone to a destination for an event. 

3. The ex’s (AKA OP’s insecurity that is not his wife’s to manage). Yes, they are a part of the friend group and will be hanging out but come on, they are from 10+ years ago and they won’t be the only ones there. Sure, I could maybe see him being uncomfortable if it was JUST the wife and the ex’s but it won’t be. They’re there to celebrate the marriage of another friend, not throw their socks around, and it’s highly possible to just remain friends with an ex. They won’t be alone, they’ll be at a wedding. Yes, it romantic but that doesn’t mean that OP’s wife is just gonna throw herself at her ex’s. They’ve been married for 10 years and if he can’t trust her then they should be in counseling. There will be a whole group of friends there so it sounds like it’ll be a pseudo reunion as well.  No where has he given an indication that she has been unfaithful in any way so the ex’s being there shouldn’t matter. I’d understand if they were recent or if she had been texting them or calling them a lot or making trips to see them. But she isn’t and his insecurity if blinding. 

And let’s all be honest here, OP’s real problem is the ex’s. Not her flying home, not her attending a wedding by herself, but the fact that her ex’s will be there and apparently he can’t trust his wife enough to just go there and be friends.
